description: Free: sets the hostname's A, AAAA, TXT, ACME TXT or HTTPS records; fields left out stay as they are, [] deletes. Give explicit public addresses: the caller's own address ('auto') is not available here, because through MCP it would be your client's server, not your machine (routers use /nic/update). Pass the hostname token (jdh_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password.

a.description: IPv4 addresses (public). [] deletes. Explicit addresses only.

aaaa.description: IPv6 addresses (public). [] deletes. Explicit addresses only.

api_key.description: Instead of token: an account API key (jdk_...) whose scope covers this object (read, or write for changes).

token.description: The hostname token (jdh_...); or give api_key.

txt.description: TXT values at the hostname. [] deletes.

name: hostname_update
title: Update a dynamic hostname's addresses (free, token)
